sources.title: Maryland Code, Health-General § 19-345 (Involuntary transfer or discharge)
sources.notes: The standing packet's 2026-08-30 capture note says curl returns only site chrome with no statute text here and that this source needed the session's fetch tool. Re-tested 2026-09-13: plain curl with a browser user-agent now returns the full statute text inside div#StatuteText -- a fact about the site today, checked rather than assumed, the same kind of correction recorded for two California sources on 2026-08-30. #StatuteText carries the section text plus 'Previous'/'Next' pager links the standing packet's hand capture omitted; the quoted text itself is unaffected, and is a subset of what this scope captures.

sources.title: COMAR 10.07.09.10, Resident Transfers and Discharges
sources.source_date: chapter administrative history: Regulations .01—.20 adopted effective April 22, 1996; Regulation .12A amended effective August 24, 2009
sources.notes: dsd.maryland.gov redirects (301) to the Library of Maryland Regulations at regs.maryland.gov/us/md/exec/comar/10.07.09.10; capture.py's curl follows redirects by default (-L in CURL_ARGS). The standing packet's Source 2 concatenates four regulations (.10 through .13) fetched separately under one SOURCE header; this recipe keeps them as four separate sources (n=2 through 5) instead, since a recipe source is one URL per fetch -- the same text ends up in the packet either way, and check-fidelity.py matches quoted spans against the whole packet body regardless of source numbering. main#area__content holds the regulation text plus the chapter breadcrumb and a short site-chrome header; no other landmark separates them on this template.
